toast.intervalsSaved: Pickup times saved for this event
toast.printMode: {mode, select, onConfirmed {Tickets will print when you accept an order} other {Tickets will print shortly before pickup}}
toast.cardPayments: {state, select, off {Card payments off — customers pay at the window} other {Card payments back on}}
toast.intervalsFailed: Pickup times could not be saved right now.

demo.lockBody: This is where you start and close a service, pause orders when the line gets long, or switch to a different event.

cancelModal.noRefund: The order will be canceled and the {amount} will stay with you. Nothing goes back to the customer’s card.
cancelModal.held: Their card is held, not charged — nothing has been charged, so there is nothing to refund. Canceling releases the hold right away.

banner.cardPaymentsOff: Card payments are off — customers are paying at the window. This stays off, on every event, until you turn it back on.

orders.status: {status, select, pending {New} confirmed {Confirmed} rejected {Rejected} modified {Modified} cancelled {Canceled} cooking {Cooking} ready {Ready} collected {Picked up} other {{status}}}

settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off during a card problem and customers will place orders as normal and pay at the window instead. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
settings.intervalsHelp: How far apart pickup times are. This doesn’t change kitchen capacity or prep times.
settings.intervalsUnavailable: Pickup times are unavailable right now.
settings.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward the total capacity. Cooked categories always count; check instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
settings.countsTick: Check to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared per-window limit

stock.howCategory: Category total is a shared pool across every item in that category (e.g. 30 appetizers tonight).
stock.howAvailable: Available: green = on sale, gray = sold out (hidden from customers).

kds.body: Choose which truck’s kitchen screen to open:

eventBar.status: {tone, select, paused {⏸ Paused} live {● Live} finished {● Finished} cancelled {Canceled} other {Not started}}
